description: This file defines the data structures, classes, and interfaces for managing User Equipment (UE) context within a Distributed Unit (DU) in a 5G NR network, including context storage, control interfaces, and related enumerations.

classes.name: du_ue_context
classes.description: Stores the context information of a User Equipment (UE) in the Distributed Unit (DU), including identifiers and cell information.

classes.name: du_ue_controller
classes.description: Interface for controlling and interacting with the state of a DU UE, including RLF detection and traffic management.

classes.name: du_ue
classes.description: Represents a DU UE, inheriting context and control functionalities, managing bearers, resources, and mobility state.

methods.name: disable_rlf_detection
methods.description: Disables the detection of Radio Link Failures (RLF) for the UE.

methods.name: handle_activity_stop_request
methods.description: Stops traffic for the UE's radio bearers and RLF detection, with an option to stop SRBs.

methods.name: handle_drb_stop_request
methods.description: Stops traffic for a subset of DRBs during reconfiguration.

methods.name: schedule_async_task
methods.description: Schedules an asynchronous task for the UE.

methods.name: handle_rlf_detection
methods.description: Handles detection of RLF in MAC or RLC layers.

methods.name: handle_crnti_ce_detection
methods.description: Handles detection of a C-RNTI MAC Control Element for the UE.

methods.name: get_mac_rlf_notifier
methods.description: Provides access to the MAC RLF notifier for the UE.

methods.name: get_rlc_rlf_notifier
methods.description: Provides access to the RLC RLF notifier for the UE.
